title: openai-compat: tool_choice semantics, schema mapping and tool message formatting fixes
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: The OpenAI compatibility layer's handling of tool calling has diverged in three places: (1) tool_choice resolution did not follow the documented semantics when multiple tools matched a call, causing nondeterministic selection; (2) schema mapping between OpenAI tool JSON schemas and Redwood's internal typed-tool descriptions lacked normalization for nested objects and arrays which resulted in runtime validation errors; (3) tool response message formatting emitted inconsistent message roles and missing structured payload fields for downstream consumers. This PR consolidates fixes across those areas, adds regression tests, and updates docs. Changes: - Implement deterministic tool_choice resolution: prefer exact-name matches, then best-schema-score, then registration-order fallback. - New schema_mapper module: normalizes OpenAI-style JSON Schema (properties, required, additionalProperties) into Redwood tool schemas, with explicit handling for nested objects and arrays. - Fix message formatting: tool responses emitted via the compatibility shim now include a top-level "tool" role when appropriate, and always include the original tool_name and serialized JSON payload under a consistent key ("tool_payload") so SDKs can deserialize reliably. - Add integration tests that exercise streaming + tool calling, and a regression test reproducing SUP-4432. - Update docs/openai-compat/tool-calling.md with clarified semantics and examples. Checklist: - [x] Implementation - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Docs updated - [x] Reviewed and approved Notes: This touches runtime selection semantics that downstream consumers may rely on; the new behavior prefers deterministic selection and is documented. Backwards compatibility: callers that relied on nondeterministic selection should pin tool registrations or use explicit tool_name in calls. See release notes below.

release_notes:
- Fix: deterministic tool_choice selection to avoid nondeterministic tool selection in compat layer.
- Fix: schema mapping normalization for nested objects and arrays to prevent runtime validation errors.
- Fix: consistent tool message formatting (adds 'tool' role and 'tool_payload' key).
- Docs: clarify tool calling semantics and migration guidance (see docs/openai-compat/tool-calling.md).
test_plan: Unit tests added for resolver tie-breakers and schema mapper edge cases. Integration test covers streaming + tool calling end-to-end with mocked tools and verifies formatted messages. Manual QA: run local compat e2e with example_tool.json and verify SDKs deserialize tool_payload correctly.
notes_on_backward_compat: Behavior change: tool_choice selection is now deterministic (exact-name > schema-score > registration-order). This may change which tool is called when multiple tools equally match; recommend pinning tool names in calls or updating registrations. A temporary compat shim is provided in scripts/compat_migration_notes.md.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: existing customers relying on previous nondeterministic selection may see different tools invoked. Mitigation: documented migration path, rollout behind a feature flag for Dedicated/Private customers, and a one-week monitoring window with alerts on tool-call error rates.
